hdg.name: Human defect grade

scale.0: accurate: looks the same as the Chromium render to the eye (anti-aliasing or a slightly different font are fine)
scale.1: defective: still usable, but something is wrong (text gone, shadow/blur missing, one wrong colour or shape)
scale.2: broken: not usable (solid black or gray blocks, blank render, large parts missing)

hdg.rated_by: draft by Claude from side-by-side thumbnails; a human is expected to review and correct it
